slides.title: HTML
slides.body:
Semantic Elements
        Semantics = Meaning of a piece of code
HTML Semantic elements are those elements that clearly describe their meaning to both browser and the developer
slides.notes:
→ Just by seeing at the code (with elements) the developer should able to understand what’s its purpose

→ Meanwhile when browser executes our code and shows output even it should understand what that element will do

Examples - h1 Element

Artificial Intelligence

The

element is a semantic element, it represents a “top-level heading” within a webpage

slides.title: Improves Accessibility
slides.body:
Improves Accessibility
Advantages of Semantic Elements
Correct usage of Semantic Elements helps Screen readers to read and communicate content more accurately
slides.notes:
→ Image should be improved

Screen readers → Assistive technology for blind and visually impaired people that read out the website content and help them 



Screen readers are an assistive technology used primarily by people who are blind. As you may guess, screen readers read out loud the text on the screen, but they also give contextual clues about every element in the UI and the actions available. In doing so, they empower people who are blind or have low vision to use technology with the same amount of independence as anyone else
